Chapter 1107: Chapter 29: Forget It, I Won’t Pretend Anymore (Please Subscribe)

In the high sky of the battlefield.

Thunder Spear Great Honored watched as the Origin Thunderclap he released with accumulated power was easily pierced and torn apart by Lin Yuan’s outstretched sky-covering hand.

His gaze briefly fell into a stupor.

To be honest, Thunder Spear Great Honored was quite confident in his Origin Thunderclap, a killing move he had nurtured for a million years.

He wouldn’t have used it this time if not to leave a good impression on Spirit Might King and breakthrough defenses as quickly as possible.

As for why not use the Origin Thunderclap against Lin Yuan?

Lin Yuan is also a Great Lord and has hidden his strength.

Compared to Lin Yuan, that B-class war machine is clearly much easier to deal with.

B-class war machine, accommodating thousands of dominant realm powerhouses, can indeed pose a threat to Great Lord level powerhouses with a single strike.

But a war machine is ultimately just a war machine, far less flexible than a Great Lord.

In the eyes of a Great Lord, a war machine appears rigid without external influence, put a Great Lord against a war machine of the same tier.

The final victor is bound to be the Great Lord.

The greatest use of a war machine is on the battlefield, teaming with other war machines and Great Lord-level powerhouses on the same side.

Therefore.

Thunder Spear Great Honored chose to strike the B-class war machine after careful consideration.

This was the safest approach.

What Thunder Spear Great Honored never anticipated was that his full-powered Origin Thunderclap was like thin paper before Lin Yuan, directly torn apart and penetrated.

“How is this possible?”

The first thought in Thunder Spear Great Honored’s mind was disbelief.

To tear his Origin Thunderclap so easily, even if not a peak Great Lord, would not be far off.

Galaxy Great Lord?

Isn’t Galaxy Great Lord a newly promoted Great Lord from a thousand years ago?

But immediately.

Thunder Spear Great Honored realized the intelligence he obtained must have had issues.

It’s only from Lord Qingfen’s word that Galaxy Great Lord was newly promoted, without any evidence to prove Galaxy Great Lord had only broken through a thousand years ago.

…

“Not good.”

“Thunder Spear Great Honored is shameless.”

Inside the B-class war machine, unicorned man ‘Luo Peng’ sensed the overwhelming terrifying thunderclaps enveloping them.

Though not yet close, the unicorned man ‘Luo Peng’ instinctive fear permeated the thunderclaps through time and space.

If not for the war machine’s protection, he probably wouldn’t be able to even resist the aura emitted by the thunderclaps.

“Hard to withstand.”

In a flash, the unicorned man ‘Luo Peng’ vaguely concluded in his mind that the B-class war machine itself might not be completely destroyed under the thunderclaps.

But the thousands of dominant realm within the war machine likely couldn’t withstand the permeating thunder force, even just a little bit would easily obliterate a large number of dominant realm powerhouses.

With a loss of many dominant realm powerhouses, the war machine is like rootless water, essentially useless.

And the permeating thunderclaps could very likely cause the war machine itself to start ‘self-destructing’.

“Try to hold on as much as possible.”

The unicorned man ‘Luo Peng’ felt desperate but still didn’t give up, hoping to at least stall Thunder Spear Great Honored’s attention to buy some response time for Galaxy Great Lord.

However.

Just then.

The unicorned man ‘Luo Peng’ witnessed an unforgettable scene.

Under the cover of boundless terrifying thunderclaps, a sky-covering hand reached in, and the overwhelming thunderclaps were weak before this sky-covering hand, unable to delay or obstruct it at all.

Swoosh!

The sky-covering hand reached in, directly lifting the massive B-class war machine, holding it in the palm and protecting it.

“Did Galaxy Great Lord make a move?”

The unicorned man ‘Luo Peng’ was a bit dazed, from the aura emitted by the sky-covering hand, he could ascertain it was Galaxy Great Lord.

But Galaxy Great Lord… so powerful?

Although the unicorned man ‘Luo Peng’ was at the peak of the dominant realm, his status as a controller of the B-class war machine was certainly not ordinary, aware that even among Great Lords, there are distinctions in strength.

And Galaxy Great Lord’s strength seems excessively potent.

…

“The war machine is fine.”

From afar, Lin Yuan observed the B-class war machine, the Chaos Secret Patterns contained within the war machine had yet to be fully understood by him.

If it were destroyed by Thunder Spear Great Honored, Lin Yuan couldn’t be sure if another B-class war machine would be deployed.

And these war machines were Lin Yuan’s hope to reach the peak of Chaos Second Realm, and even Third Realm in the shortest time.

“Originally, I just wanted to muddle through, as long as this defensive line was held, everyone would remain peaceful, mainly depending on the situation at the core defensive line battlefield.”

Lin Yuan felt a bit helpless inside.

Currently, his real strength nears the peak Great Lord.

Not enough to impact or change the course of the war, so this time against Thunder Spear Great Honored’s offensive, he only intended to defend.

As for defeating?

Even if defeated, what then? The strategy of the Red Pine King is primarily defense-focused, defeating wouldn’t mean attacking into the Purple Dream Domain.

And this is an edge of the defensive line region, even attacking inside wouldn’t have a significant impact.

But Thunder Spear Great Honored insisted on going all out, adopting a stance of risking life and limb for the Purple Dream Domain, even planning to first destroy the war machines on Qingfen Domain’s side.

Realizing this, Lin Yuan had no choice but to reveal his true strength.

If he hadn’t shown his real strength at that moment, rescuing the war machine would have been difficult.

Even if Lin Yuan could endure watching the war machine be destroyed, losing a B-class war machine would certainly place Qingfen Domain at a disadvantage.
